model_meta.system_name: US7520200B2 bar feeder and bar machining system (prepared-patent scope)
model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of the bar feeder and bar machining system disclosed in the prepared US7520200B2 evidence only. US10036408B2 was requested but is not identified by the prepared HTML or evidence; no claims are made about that patent or about any relationship between the two patents.

subsystems.description: Supports multiple bars in a line on an inclined support surface and presents a bar for take-out.
Pushes one bar from the rack to a swing member, supports it during downward rotation, and releases it into the guide rail; its empty swing position can clear the ejection space.

parts.description: Rotation shaft located above the guide rail and supporting the swing member.
Swing member attached to the rotation shaft, with a radially extending receiving face.
Arc-shaped guide surface that guides a selected bar toward the guide rail.
Bar push-up device that supplies one bar from the rack to the swing member.

subsystems.description: Receives the dropped bar and guides it toward the bar machining apparatus.
Receives a bar fed along the guide rail for machining.
Provides the manual operation that initiates the removal mode for removing a bar residing in the guide rail.
Controls normal-mode swing motion and responds to operator operation in removal mode by inhibiting bar supply and moving the empty swing member to an ejection-clear position.

item_flows.name: Selected bar
item_flows.notes: Bar supplied one at a time from rack to swing member.

item_flows.name: Released bar
item_flows.notes: Bar falls into guide rail when receiving face passes beyond the rail; claim 1.

item_flows.name: Fed bar
item_flows.notes: Guide rail directs bar to machining apparatus.

item_flows.name: Swing motion control
item_flows.notes: Controls normal downward motion and return; in removal mode positions empty swing member for ejection clearance.

item_flows.name: Bar supply inhibition
item_flows.notes: Prevents transfer from rack to swing member in removal mode.

steps.description: Rotate swing member downward from its upper standby position.
Receive one bar from the rack at a position during the downward swing.
Continue downward along the guide surface until the receiving face passes beyond the guide rail and the bar falls into it.
Reverse swing member toward the upper position and hold it in standby.
On operator operation, inhibit transfer of bars from rack to swing member.
Move swing member without a bar to its lower or further normally rotated position, creating ejection space between shaft and rack.

assumptions: The prepared workspace identifies US7520200B2, not the user-stated US10036408B2; the model uses the patent actually supplied by workspace context and indexed HTML.
The bar machining apparatus is modeled as an external receiving subsystem because detailed machining functions are not described in the cited passages.
Controller is modeled separately although claims may locate it in the bar machining apparatus; the model does not assert its physical location.
warnings: Patent identifier mismatch: requested US10036408B2, prepared patent context and HTML are US7520200B2.
Model is a concept abstraction; optional embodiments such as rail lift, movable regulation support, and cam-linked push-up details are omitted for concision.
